from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "tests"))
from test_mtp_cache_reuse import test_completed_chat_reuses_only_new_turn_tokens
from llama_cpp import Llama, LlamaConfig, disable_logging
disable_logging()
model="/home/lianghong/Projects/llama_cpp_projects/models/Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M-MTP.gguf"
for stream in [False, True]:
    cfg=LlamaConfig(model_path=model,n_ctx=512,n_batch=32,n_ubatch=16,n_threads=4,n_threads_batch=4,n_gpu_layers=-1)
    assert cfg.n_rs_seq == 2
    with Llama(model, config=cfg) as llm:
        test_completed_chat_reuses_only_new_turn_tokens(llm, stream)
        print("default snapshots=2", "stream",stream,"passed",flush=True)
